question: What is the angle of elevation of the sun when the shadow of a 9-m high pole is 3sqrt 3 m long?
solution:
Given data:

Length of pole = 9 m

Length of shadow of the pole = 3√3 m

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/755161200461042ee6100874542431d0e0cb72b064dcfe78f335488dba4f612d.png] 

In the right-angled triangle ABC

tan θ = AC / BC

⇒ tan θ = 9 / 3√3

⇒ tan θ = √3

∴ θ = 60º

∴ The angle of the elevation of the sun is 60º.
